newsitem.title: INDIA: India rupee ends at 35.64/65, dlr demand picks up.
newsitem.headline: India rupee ends at 35.64/65, dlr demand picks up.

text.p: The Indian rupee closed at 35.64/65 on Friday compared to the opening quote of 35.63/64 amid some signs that corporate demand for dollars was picking up, dealers said.
"But there is no big demand yet," said a broker.
Consistent bidding for dollars by a major bank in the morning session put mild pressure on the rupee.
The dollar saw a high of 35.6525 during the day, a dealer said. "The spread was between two to two-and a-half paise today," said a dealer at the Bombay office of a foreign bank.
The forward dollar market saw some paying interest in the morning session but receivers dominated the scene thereafter. The six month annualised dollar premium closed at 8.70 percent.
